messages:
Priya (PM): Quick flag from support: customers confused by the Encryption badge + region ordering in the workspace settings. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/ux/encrypt-badge.png

Priya (PM): They inboxed saying the badge reads \"Encrypted (KMS)\" but audit logs show raw key IDs. Also retention copy says \"Your data is retained for X days\" — customers want to know if KMS affects retention.

Owen (Design): Reproduced. Badge sits left of title and reads like a status+type. When the region dropdown has "Global" first, people assume keys are global too. Bad combo.

Hana (Security): Audit logs shouldn't surface key IDs in the UI by default. We should display the KMS alias or truncated/friendly name. Also we must be explicit: \"KMS controls encryption only; it does not change retention or residency policies.\"

Theo (A11y): Two nits: focus ring on badge is disabled in compact header (keyboard users lose context) and the KMS label contrast is 3.8:1 in light theme (fail).

Owen (Design): Proposal: change badge to \"Encryption: Customer key\" with a subtle shield icon. Move region selector above the \"Scope / storage\" subsection so it reads as storage selection. Audit log line should render: \"KMS: alias/my-key (redacted-id)\" not raw id.

Priya (PM): Suggested help copy to include where to find keys and effect: \"Choosing a customer key encrypts data at rest. Retention and allowed regions are configured separately below.\"

ux-bot: Draft mock copy:
```
Encryption: Customer key  [shield icon]
KMS: alias/my-corp-key  (redacted-0f3a...)
Help: Choosing a customer key encrypts workspace data at rest. This does not change retention or region residency settings.
```

Theo (A11y): For aria: `role=status` for the badge with `aria-live=polite` so screen readers pick up changes. Add `aria-label=\"Encryption: customer-managed key enabled\"` when toggle is on. Also put the region dropdown after the toggle in DOM order even if visually above for sighted users.

Hana (Security): Agree on alias display. Also add a copy line in audit logs: \"Viewed by [user] at [time] - KMS alias shown; key id truncated for safety.\"

Owen (Design): I'll update the mock. Small visual change for focus: add 3px outline on keyboard focus and bump contrast to meet AA (4.5:1) for the label.

Priya (PM): Can we scope as P2? Low UI effort but security + audit clarity. I'll open a ticket with ACs: alias in audit view, copy updates to help text, badge wording, keyboard focus fix, aria changes, DOM order tweak. Include before/after screenshots.

Priya (PM): Filed: https://linear.app/RW/issue/UX-4999 "Key alias + encryption badge clarity" assigned to Owen.

Owen (Design): Will send mock by EOD and include dark/light frames.

Theo (A11y): I can run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver pass once mock is posted.

Hana (Security): I'll update audit logging docs to show redaction rules.

Priya (PM): Thanks team :tada:
